{{Quote|Never go into space with someone braver than you.|Conventional SpaceOps wisdom|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />}}
The '''Marines''', also known as '''SpaceOps''', were a division of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Comprised of tough, hardened [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], the Marines were specially trained to fight aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and in zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Equipped with light weaponry so as not to cause undue damage to their environment during combat, Marines generally wore light [[Armor/Legends|armor]], or [[armored spacesuit]]s.

==Organization==
{{Quote|Never send a generalist to do an expert's job.|Colonel Anena Seertay, Alliance High Command Regimental Marine Commander|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />}}
The Marines,<ref name="RASB" /> also referred to as "SpaceOps,"<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> were a military speciality within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="RASB" /> The first [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of each of the ten SpecForce [[Division/Legends|divisions]] was designated as the Marine Regiment.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Marines were trained for combat aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], with typical mission profiles including boarding and capturing enemy vessels, repelling invaders aboard their own craft,<ref name="RASB" /> or as the vanguard of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] landing assault. In addition to their combat role, Marines were deployed as security personnel throughout the ships on which they were assigned,<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> posted to critical areas when the likelihood of enemy boarders was probable.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Marine units relied on fast-moving assaults, using firepower and numbers to overwhelm the enemy, and were not above withdrawing in the face of stiff opposition.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

==History==
{{Quote|The only thing worse than a fight is ''waiting'' for a fight.|Overheard comment on SpaceOps shuttle|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />}}
[[File:Able-Rebellion2.jpg|right|thumb|The clone trooper Able served as a rebel marine under Sergeant Basso]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], SpecForce Marines were deployed as part of [[Operation Cobolt]], a mission to retrieve a [[Scandoc decoding computer]] from an [[Imperial orbital base|orbital base]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. A Marine unit using an [[Assault boat/Legends|assault boat]] breached the cargo doors on the station after an [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]] team disabled the base's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The Marines established an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] to allow more Marines&mdash;[[White Team (Operation Cobolt)|White Team]], [[Black Team (Operation Cobolt)|Black Team]], and [[Red Team (Operation Cobolt)|Red Team]]&mdash;in a [[Wolden-class shuttle|''Wolden''-class shuttle]] to enter the station to retrieve the decoding computer and sabotage the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power station]]. Once the objectives had been achieved, the survivors withdrew and the station fell into Mantooine's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="WEG:GMRoOC">{{WEGCite|story=General Madine's Report on Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> Marines commanded by [[Able|BL-1707]] and [[Basso]] were deployed via [[YM-2800 limpet ship]] to take [[Raid on an Imperial cargo convoy|control]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cargo convoy.<ref name="R2:MB,ME,2">[[Rebellion 2|''Rebellion'' 2]]</ref>

As the Galactic Civil War moved from a state of insurgency and hit and run guerrilla assaults, the Marines were expected to be attached to standard [[line division]]s, alongside [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] units to assist in spearheading planetary assault and landings.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

==Personnel==
[[File:SpaceOps_Trooper.jpg|left|thumb|A SpaceOps trooper]]
{{Quote|Squad: Let's party!|SpaceOps in combat and on leave|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />}}
SpecForce Marines were generally beings who were already comfortable with living in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]; having either grown up around ships and ports, or spent a significant portion of their life in space. They were able to cope with the confinement inherent in space travel and living amongst the [[Star/Legends|stars]], and were used to the boredom that came with journeying through space on long voyages. Despite being around ships, the Marines almost never developed skills like [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] starships, or even [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]]. Because of their background, when the beings joined the Alliance, they were assigned ship-board duties until they requested a transfer to Special Forces, where they were inducted into the Marines due to their experiences. After completing [[drop camp]], Marines were transferred directly to vessels throughout the Fleet and were trained on the job. Additional training was achieved through drills on [[Moon/Legends|moons]] or in deep space. Training in ship boarding, space combat and assaults were conducted in remote locations, such as deep space or remote planetoids, often against derelict and stripped hulks. Training in space weapons was conducted alongside [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] squads.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

Marine life was tough, and the personnel were fighters at heart, thick-skinned and hard-headed with a reputation for charging into the fray. They were considered to be thick-headed by other Specs, although not directly, and were often referred to as "vacheads." Officially, the nickname was derived from their operational environment. Marines also had a reputation for being vicious in combat, a result of the long periods spent aboard ship and in close company throughout the duration of their [[tour of duty]]. A Marine's goal was simple. Complete the mission, stay alive, protect their squadmates, and make it intact to the next shore leave.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

During the Galactic Civil War, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Anena Seertay]] was the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] Special Forces Regimental Marine Commander. Seertay was [[Death/Legends|killed in action]] during the [[Primtara Offensive]].<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Colonel [[Anna Seertay/Legends|Anna Seertay]] commanded the Marine boarding force that assaulted the Imperial orbital base over Mantooine during Operation Cobolt, while [[Gideon (rebel)|Gideon]] and [[Toombs]] led the follow-up Marine assault teams.<ref name="WEG:MotPMfOC">{{WEGCite|story=Minutes of the Planning Meeting for Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> Seertay and Toombs were killed in action during the mission.<ref name="WEG:GMRoOC" />

[[Team 19]] was a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]-sized unit based aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mantan Wanderer]]'', which was part of the [[14th Roving Line]]. Under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Miko Beski]], Team 19 was comprised of three Marine squads, a [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] squad, and a squad of [[Technicians/Legends|Technicians]]. They were utilized as the main boarding party force, and the core of the planetary assault force.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

==Skills==
{{Quote|If the shields are down, the marines can crack the cargo doors, no problem. One assault boat should do it &mdash; it will also serve to draw enemy fire, showing us which guns are still operable and must be taken out before the transport gets within range.|Anna Seertay|<ref name="WEG:MotPMfOC" />}}
Marines were trained in close quarters fighting,<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]],<ref name="RECG" /> and zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] engagements. Marines spent the majority of their time developing and honing the combat skills and tactics required to fight aboard starships and other confined structures in space. Technical skills were given a secondary emphasis, while stealth training was kept to a bare minimum.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Marines also had access to the Alliance's small collection of [[armored spacesuit]]s and [[battle suit]]s,<ref name="RASB" /> and received training in their operation.<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Marines were able to identify which weapons were suitable to be deployed in certain areas of a ship to prevent undue damage to the vessel during combat operations. They were also trained in sabotage of shipboard systems. All Marines were capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="RECG" />

Marines were combat experts; they were trained to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and were skilled in both unarmed combat<ref name="RASB" /> and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]], especially in zero-gravity. Marines had survival training with an emphasis on space survival, and were capable of applying first aid. In their role as shipboard security troops, Marines were trained to use the weapons aboard both [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and space [[Transport/Legends|transports]], and could also assisting in repairs to the vessels if needed. Marines were also able to bypass security systems.<ref name="RASB2" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Marine.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A Marine in battle armor]]
{{Quote|That gives us room for about 75 troopers and maybe 1000 kilos of equipment. It'll be tight. If we're wearing space suits, you can cut down our efficiency and speed by 18 percent.|Toombs|<ref name="WEG:MotPMfOC" />}}
Marines were generally armed with light weapons to avoid causing damage to the interior of the starship they were in, but did use heavier weapons when attacking an enemy vessel. Armor-wise, Marines wore either a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]],<ref name="RECG" /> or an armored spacesuit or battle suit. Marines also liked [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] [[Thinsuit/Legends|thinsuits]] due to their utility.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Standard weapons included [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]],<ref name="RASB2" /> [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]],<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]],<ref name="RASB2" />&mdash;including [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]]<ref name="RECG" />&mdash;and a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]]. Marines also had access to either a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light]] or [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]], although the weapons were generally impractical to deploy aboard starships,<ref name="RASB2" /> and [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] [[Flame Carbine|flame carbines]].<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> An encrypted [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] allowed the Marine to remain in contact with their unit.<ref name="RECG" />

Marine forces were commonly deployed through use of [[Katarn-class boarding shuttle|''Katarn''-class boarding shuttles]], or [[Aegis-class Combat Shuttle|''Aegis''-class combat shuttles]].<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />
